trace_source.scope: Three-screen automated navigation with actual scrolling, popular/recommendation and mine/dynamics switching; not a pure home-scroll benchmark.

trace_integrity.boundary_note: One unmatched end and one unclosed begin occur at trace boundaries; summary uses complete paired slices.

observations: The longer measured wall-clock slices occur in Flutter raster/paint/submission; native layout and typical UI callbacks are shorter in this mixed window.
SwapBuffers wall time can include blocking or unlabelled driver work; it is not a direct CPU/GPU busy measurement.
Kawase blur markers demonstrate native filter activity, but their short synchronous duration is not the full GPU cost and does not prove blur is free or the primary cause.
coverage_limits: Nested slice totals overlap: surface submission includes swap/flush work and must not be added to them as independent load.
No useful image decode or upload markers support a decoder bottleneck attribution or prove decoding absent.
PresentFence observation/wait slices do not establish complete Flutter-frame-to-presentation mapping or kernel fence signal/scheduler coverage; no actual FPS or drop-rate claim.
This is a ten-second mixed automated emulator workload with host and instrumentation effects, not a physical-device or pure-scroll acceptance benchmark.
No matched-action A/B run isolates native material cost; no all-bug-free or zero-jank conclusion.
